method: Exported Gerber polarity booleans, arcs approximated to 1 um; connectivity only through actual copper and captured plated vias/component holes. Point lookup tolerance 3 um; no tolerance joining separate polygons.
limitations: Assumes all captured through vias/PTH component pads are manufactured and plated correctly.
Does not validate impedance, signal integrity, thermal performance or real connector contact wiring.
Only declared component pads, vias and routed traces are assigned electrical nets; anonymous copper islands are not functional nets.
